infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: overrrrhere connects to your Xbox on your home network to stream your games.

plugins.cameraPermission: overrrrhere never uses your camera. The streaming component declares this permission, but the app never asks for it.
plugins.microphonePermission: overrrrhere never uses your microphone. The streaming component declares this permission, but the app never asks for it.

plugins.photosPermission: overrrrhere uses your photos only when you choose a custom tile or background image.
